name: WARNING: Peet's Coffee Bacon & Havarti Panini (Rough Crust & Dijon Mustard)
whyItWorks: Pressed artisan rustic roll with sharp, hard-toasted crusts that pose mechanical swallowing and transit abrasion. Filled with greasy bacon strips and whole-grain Dijon mustard seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose soft brioche breakfast sandwiches or plain oatmeal rather than hard-pressed paninis.
